title: What's new in v2.3.1
intro: This update fixes image metadata imports and installation packaging.
items: Fixed tag selections being overwritten when performer selection was also enabled.
Performer selections are now enabled for all selected photos by default and can be deselected per image.
Imported images now use the PornPics gallery page as their URL instead of the CDN image URL.
Imported images now use the PornPics gallery title as their image title.
Added installation-safe packages that always include the UI files.
footer: Please post a reply on the plugin page if something goes wrong!
